verdict.rationale: Speech is Cheap's own integration docs describe automations that run without a person starting each job: they automatically transcribe audio from Google Drive into Google Sheets or a Zapier Table. These run as asynchronous jobs with webhook completion updates. The automation itself appears to depend on third-party integration platforms rather than a native automation feature. Missing for 10: native first-party scheduling or trigger configuration, detailed docs on how the background automations are set up and run, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
